combo_label: Food & Drink × Disney × The Wild West

entries.clue: Vast rolling sea of grass where the bison once thundered
Bouncing green goo cooked up by an absent-minded professor
Little bake in a fluted paper case, sometimes given butterfly wings
Swinging orangutan who wants to learn about man's red fire
Looped rope a rider whirls overhead to catch a running calf
Band of armed townsfolk riding out together to run down a gang
Genoese sauce named for the pounding that makes it
Loyal reindeer who hauls an ice harvester's sled and craves carrots
Swing-door drinking den with a piano and a card game in the corner
Cheery snowman who daydreams about what summer might feel like
Doner or shish: spit-carved or skewered meat bundled into flatbread
Meat chopped fine by machine, browned as the base of a cottage pie
